# TeeVents

> All-in-one golf tournament management software for charity, corporate, and nonprofit golf tournaments. Branded event sites, online registration, live scoring, sponsors, pairings, and automated payments via Stripe Connect.

TeeVents offers a free tier with a 5% platform fee covered by players at checkout, plus per-event ($299), per-league ($499), and enterprise ($2,999/year) plans. Every plan includes a named dedicated TeeVents rep who builds your event page, registration, leaderboard, sponsor page, pairings, and scoring setup — free or paid. Optional add-ons are $99 each.

## Pricing

- No Cost to Start: $0 + 5% platform fee (covered by players)
- Per-Event: $299 per tournament
- Per-League: $499 per league
- Enterprise: $2,999 per year (unlimited events)
- Add-ons: $99 each
